summary: Generates simple mathematical line-strip shapes in X, Y, and Z or writes math-function values into attributes. Functions include sine, cosine, triangle, square, ease curves, and random, with controls for repeats, phase, bias, exponent, and reranging.

key_params.name: numpoints
key_params.note: Number of points generated

key_params.name: cyclic
key_params.note: Treats complete cycles as Number of Points + 1 values

key_params.name: connectivity
key_params.note: Output none, line strip, lines, or point primitives

key_params.name: parsize
key_params.note: Number of independently configured parameter lanes

key_params.name: type
key_params.note: Pattern function type for each lane

key_params.name: seed
key_params.note: Seed for random pattern types

key_params.name: numcycles
key_params.note: Number of cycles over the pattern length

key_params.name: steppercycle
key_params.note: Step added to each cycle

key_params.name: bias
key_params.note: Bias for triangle and square pattern shapes

key_params.name: phase
key_params.note: Phase shift of the pattern

key_params.name: exp
key_params.note: Exponent applied to the internal pattern value

key_params.name: fromlow
key_params.note: Input low range for reranging pattern values

key_params.name: fromhigh
key_params.note: Input high range for reranging pattern values

key_params.name: tolow
key_params.note: Output low range for reranging pattern values

key_params.name: tohigh
key_params.note: Output high range for reranging pattern values

key_params.name: reverse
key_params.note: Reverse pattern order

key_params.name: linebreakcycle
key_params.note: Outputs breaks at each cycle

key_params.name: closed
key_params.note: Connect the last vertex to the first vertex

key_params.name: outputlinebreakattr
key_params.note: Output a LineBreak attribute

key_params.name: texture
key_params.note: Output texture coordinates relative to cycles

key_params.name: combineop
key_params.note: Set, add, or multiply when combining with an input attribute

key_params.name: combineattrscope
key_params.note: Input attribute scope used for combine operations

key_params.name: outputattrscope
key_params.note: Output attribute scope such as P, Color, Tex, PointScale, or custom

key_params.name: overrideautoattr
key_params.note: Override automatic output attribute typing

key_params.name: attrtype
key_params.note: Output data type when overriding automatic typing

key_params.name: attrnumcomps
key_params.note: Output component count

key_params.name: attrdefaultval
key_params.note: Default output value if pattern evaluation cannot be computed

key_params.name: attrclass
key_params.note: Attribute class to operate on when filtering an input

key_params.name: group
key_params.note: Optional group limiting which elements are affected

key_concepts: Pattern POP can generate a point sequence or filter existing POP attributes with mathematical pattern functions.
Per-lane controls such as cycles, phase, bias, exponent, range mapping, and reverse make independent X/Y/Z or component curves possible.
Connectivity, closed-line, line-break, texture-coordinate, and combine controls turn generated values into usable line-strip geometry or attribute modulation.
common_gotchas: Pattern POP can be a generator or a filter; connected inputs change whether it adds/modifies attributes instead of just making P.
Set Parameter Size deliberately when independent X, Y, Z, or attribute component curves are needed.
Use Output Line Break Attribute or linebreakcycle when later line operators must preserve per-cycle segmentation.
